_comment: Matter-specific facts for the demo engagement. In a real deployment
these come from the matter record; here they are config, never the
grading rubric. This file is what keeps the RULES generic: 'addressed
to the engagement client' is a firm standard, 'addressed to Sycamore
Capital Partners' is an answer key.
Every value below is discoverable in the data room documents. That is
the test for whether a value belongs here.
DELIBERATELY ABSENT: the January 24, 2025 investment committee
meeting, which LAB's C-045 also requires. That date appears nowhere in
the 13 data room documents — only inside task.json's own criteria — so
no agent can reference it from its inputs, and C-045 fails 17/17 in
every run ever recorded. We enforce the achievable half of that
standard and let the criterion keep failing rather than pretend the
impossible half is a firm rule. Reported upstream:
_cleared_comment: Items the engagement has already dispositioned as NOT red flags.

The underlying fact is discoverable in the data room, which is this
file's standing test: environmental-permit-schedule states the Wyoming
renewal was filed 15 October 2024, before the 30 November 2024

ONE item, not four. LAB has four distractor criteria (C-032..C-035),
but only this one is checkable without false positives: matching the
